newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Kohl says Europe must not miss chance for peace.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says Europe must not miss chance for peace.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Monday that Europe faced a choice between scepticism and national isolation, on the one hand, or seizing the opportunity to build a lasting peace for the 21st century.
Kohl told fellow leaders from more than 50 nations at a European security summit in Lisbon that Eastern European countries must be allowed to join the NATO alliance.
But he said Europe must not be divided and a place must be found for Russia, which opposes NATO enlargement, and for other countries in building security.
"There can only be security in Europe with, not against, Russia," the German leader said.
"At the threshold of the 21st century, Europe stands at a great crossroads.

"We Europeans will see whether we are capable of taking this chance for a future of peace and freedom, or whether 'Euroscepticism' and withdrawal into national isolation will win the upper hand -- so that we miss the chance of the century."
